title: WorldRoPE: Probabilistic World-Centric Rotary Embedding for Multi-View Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.16337v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) is widely used to encode relative positions in Transformers. In multi-view settings, however, patch coordinates are defined independently in each image: the same 3D point can therefore have different coordinates across views, making them insufficient for establishing cross-view correspondences. We introduce WorldRoPE, a probabilistic world-centric RoPE for multi-view attention. At each layer, WorldRoPE back-projects each patch token into a set of volumetric Gaussian primitives in a shared world frame. These primitives represent multiple plausible 3D supports for a token, jointly capturing alternative depth hypotheses, depth uncertainty, and the finite spatial extent of its patch frustum. When a key token's support is projected into a query view, it induces a distribution over where that key may appear in the query image. translated_title: WorldRoPE：面向多视角注意力机制的概率性世界中心旋转位置编码
translated_abstract: 旋转位置编码被广泛用于在Transformer中编码相对位置。然而，在多视角设置下，图像块坐标是在每张图像中独立定义的：同一个3D点因此在不同视角间会具有不同的坐标，这使得它们不足以建立跨视角的对应关系。我们提出了WorldRoPE，一种面向多视角注意力的概率性世界中心RoPE。在每一层，WorldRoPE将每个图像块token反投影到共享世界坐标系中的一组体积高斯基元中。这些基元表示一个token的多个合理的3D支撑区域，共同捕捉不同的深度假设、深度不确定性，以及其图像块视锥的有限空间范围。当一个键token的支撑被投影到查询视角时，它会诱导出该键可能出现在查询图像中位置的分布。WorldRoPE以闭式形式在该分布上对旋转算子进行积分，……
tldr: WorldRoPE提出一种概率性世界中心的旋转位置编码，将图像块token反投影为共享世界坐标系中的体积高斯基元以刻画多种深度假设与不确定性，并以闭式形式在诱导分布上积分旋转算子，从而解决多视角注意力中跨视角对应关系难以建立的问题。
en_tdlr: WorldRoPE introduces a probabilistic world-centric rotary embedding that back-projects patch tokens into volumetric Gaussian primitives in a shared world frame and integrates the rotary operator in closed form over the induced distribution, enabling robust cross-view correspondences in multi-view attention.
